intel.t: "I'm a doctor. I'm a mom. I'm not a career politician": health care costs, reversing Medicaid cuts, and cost of living, as an independent voice against an unready appointee.

intel.l: Biggest vulnerability as opponents frame it
intel.t: Her past advocacy for gender affirming care for minors, which Trump and Graham's camp hit hard; she now says she opposes trans women in female sports and surgery on minors.

Outreach to Republicans and rural voters, with testimonials from lifelong Republicans and praise from Ralph Norman's son Warren; Fresh Start buys focus on the Greenville-Spartanburg and Charlotte markets.
Trump's October 5 slur against her, which former GOP Gov. David Beasley called "abhorrent"; she answered that name calling will not lower gas and grocery prices.
Trafalgar released October 19 has her down 45.6 to 48.6, tied to rising unfavorables; a Pollsmax average of ten surveys has her down 1.7.

bottom: Andrews launched on May 29, 2025 against Lindsey Graham, per the SC Daily Gazette, https://scdailygazette.com/2025/05/29/former-musc-pediatrician-announces-campaign-to-oust-lindsey-graham/. After his death she faces his sister, appointed Sen. Darline Graham. She has raised $19.7 million since launch, $9.4 million of it in the third quarter, and entered October with $2.3 million, per the SC Daily Gazette on October 20, 2026, https://scdailygazette.com/2026/10/20/sc-republicans-and-democrats-tout-their-fundraising-hauls-as-proof-of-momentum/. Graham raised $2.4 million in the same quarter. Outside money runs the other way: PACs spent $6.9 million against Andrews and $1.8 million for her.
Two interests combine money and a decision, and a third is the opposition:

**Small donors.** About 95 percent of her third quarter money came from individuals, per the Post and Courier on October 17, 2026, https://www.postandcourier.com/politics/carolina-fundraising-graham-andrews-election-senate/article_3080debc-f450-4094-8d87-6f420bd21d17.html.

**Science and health advocacy groups.** 314 Action bundled $3.6 million to her campaign. Fresh Start SC PAC spent about $871,000 for her and $1.63 million against Graham. The lever is health care law, above all Medicaid.

intel.t: Continuity with her brother and loyalty to Trump; she casts Andrews as a radical liberal and socialist who moderated for the race.

intel.l: Biggest vulnerability as opponents frame it
intel.t: Readiness: her "National security is not my thing" answer, no Social Security plan, and an appointment many see as inherited.
Upstate counties she lost in the primary and runoff, where Trump planned a stop, and a continuing write in drive for Ralph Norman.
Trump rally in Clemson on October 21 and SLF money arriving after Cook moved the race to Lean Republican.
Trafalgar released October 19: Graham 48.6, Andrews 45.6; InsiderAdvantage September 28 to 29: 46 to 45.

bottom: Graham was appointed on July 13, 2026 by Gov. Henry McMaster, on Donald Trump's recommendation, two days after the death of her brother, Sen. Lindsey Graham, per TIME on July 13, 2026, https://time.com/article/2026/07/13/darline-nordone-lindsey-graham-sister-south-carolina-senate-trump-mcmaster/. She had never held elected office. She was a commissioner on the South Carolina Commission for the Blind and had worked as director of public information for the state Vocational Rehabilitation Department. She won the special GOP runoff against Rep. Ralph Norman on August 25 with about 52 percent.

She is badly outraised. She raised $2.4 million in the third quarter, $1.1 million to her campaign and $1.3 million to a campaign tied PAC, and entered October with $610,000, per the SC Daily Gazette on October 20, 2026, https://scdailygazette.com/2026/10/20/sc-republicans-and-democrats-tout-their-fundraising-hauls-as-proof-of-momentum/. Annie Andrews raised $9.4 million in the same period. Outside groups make up the difference.
Four interests combine money and a decision she would hold:
**Senate Republican leadership.** SLF pledged about $5 million, and one source told the Post and Courier it could reach $10 million. The decision is Senate control.

D.t: Annie Andrews leads by 0.9 in the forecast and wins 53% of simulations. The cushion is about 18,452 votes; a one point swing is about 10,138 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +7.0 and D +9.1. A normal polling error decides it.
The polls page average is D +1.2. Your best recent poll is On Point Polling at D +3.5; your worst is Rasmussen Reports at R +4.5. 9 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Richland, a projected net 85,468 votes; Charleston, a projected net 52,231 votes; Orangeburg, a projected net 14,308 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Greenville, R +2.9, 10.3% of the vote; York, R +0.1, 5.6% of the vote; Berkeley, D +2.2, 4.3% of the vote; Beaufort, D +3.3, 4.2% of the vote.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Annie Andrews runs furthest behind in Oconee, Anderson, Pickens. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 76% of voters, 40 to 55, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.79 points; Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 66% of voters, 48 to 48, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.28 points; Voters without a degree, 62% of voters, 48 to 48, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.10 points.

The forecast's worst groups for Annie Andrews: Immigration voters 19 to 77, White voters 40 to 55, Voters who can afford daily costs 44 to 52. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
$4.1M cash against $251K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.

D.h: What the ballots so far say
D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 0.1 points away from Annie Andrews. Election Day has to make it up: the remaining vote must break harder your way than the forecast expects.
Activity: 7 campaign stops by the candidate or surrogates in 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Republicans: Horry, a projected net 36,602 votes; Anderson, a projected net 26,195 votes; Spartanburg, a projected net 19,547 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Greenville, R +2.9, 10.3% of the vote; York, R +0.1, 5.6% of the vote; Berkeley, D +2.2, 4.3% of the vote; Beaufort, D +3.3, 4.2% of the vote.

R.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
R.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Darline Graham runs furthest behind in Charleston, Orangeburg, Sumter. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 76% of voters, 55 to 40, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.79 points; Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 66% of voters, 48 to 48, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.28 points; Voters without a degree, 62% of voters, 48 to 48, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.10 points.
The forecast's worst groups for Darline Graham: Black voters 19 to 77, Independents 20 to 71, Moderates 29 to 65. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
$251K cash against $4.1M. Outspent: lean on earned media, digital, field and the outside groups, and pick the two or three media markets that decide it.

R.h: What the ballots so far say
R.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 0.1 points toward Darline Graham. Bank it: chase the remaining mail ballots and low propensity voters who have not voted.

media.what: Sabato's Crystal Ball moved the South Carolina Senate race from Safe Republican to Likely Republican.
Attacked Democratic nominee Dr. Annie Andrews ahead of the Republican Senate runoff, saying under the white coat is a left wing agenda.
Interviewed Democratic Senate candidate Annie Andrews.
On OutFront called out Sean Hannity for giving Sen. Darline Graham cover on her Taiwan debate gaffe after mocking a similar AOC answer.
Called South Carolina a hope for Democrats but not real.
Interviewed Sen. Darline Graham and gave her a chance to defend her Taiwan debate answer.
Predicted on The Huddle that Ralph Norman would come out ahead of Sen. Darline Graham in the GOP primary.
Called Darline Graham a total empty vessel and said her primary win is exactly what Trump wants.
Asked Sen. Tim Scott on Meet the Press whether Darline Graham is qualified to be a senator.
Fox News Power Rankings moved South Carolina Senate from Solid R to Likely R.
Inside Elections moved the South Carolina Senate race against Darline Graham from Likely Republican to Lean Republican.
Called Sen. Tim Scott such a tool after Scott used a slur about Democratic Senate candidate Annie Andrews on The Charlie Kirk Show.
